changes: Placed the security-header middleware before Swagger so headers reach Swagger UI, its static assets, and the OpenAPI document.
Added a Swagger-specific CSP that permits only same-origin resources plus the inline bootstrap required for Swagger compatibility; global API CSP remains strict.
Upgraded Swashbuckle.AspNetCore from 6.7.3 to 10.2.1 and its filters package from 9.0.0 to 10.0.1.
Updated the OpenAPI v2 integration syntax while preserving the Bearer security definition and global requirement.
Added an integration regression test for the Swagger UI response, its security headers, and its served UI assets.
